title: Rigorous High-Order Hausdorff Dimension Estimation of Limit Sets of Continued Fraction Iterated Function Systems via B-Splines
summary: We develop a method for the rigorous estimation of Hausdorff dimensions of limit sets produced by continued fraction iterated function systems. Our method is based on the approximation of a Perron-Frobenius operator using the finite element method with B-splines as the choice of basis functions. This choice provides key numerical advantages including higher-order convergence and computational flexibility.
